verdict.rationale: Retell documents all three programmatic surfaces. Official Node/Python SDKs claim full voice endpoint coverage, the official CLI manages agents and phone numbers, and the official MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and similar clients create, update and publish agents. That covers creating the agent and managing numbers without the dashboard, though the quick-start walkthrough itself is dashboard-driven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a number can be bound to an agent via API/CLI/MCP, an explicit outbound create-call endpoint or tool, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end headless flow (the OpenAPI spec probes also returned 404).
